rationale: C04 plausibly supplied a concise birthday-message template materially reused in the child: birthday wishes are followed by praise of the recipient's work as an inspiration to others. The child expands this same structure with details about Keller's accomplishments and influence. C10 shares the birthday, honor, and future-happiness elements but is less closely matched in wording and structure; C08 shares congratulatory language and a "not only ... but also" praise construction but is not a birthday message.

shared_material.child_excerpt: Please accept my warm congratulations on your forthcoming seventy-fifth birthday.
shared_material.parent_excerpt: My cordial greetings and best wishes on your eightieth birthday.
shared_material.explanation: Both open with warm wishes keyed to a milestone birthday, with the age adapted from eighty to seventy-five.

shared_material.child_excerpt: The story of your accomplishments is ... an enduring inspiration--in many lands
shared_material.parent_excerpt: Your spirit and work have been an example and inspiration to all of us.
shared_material.explanation: Both immediately characterize the honoree's work or accomplishments as an example and inspiration to others.

shared_material.child_excerpt: With all who honor you, I am glad to join in best wishes
shared_material.parent_excerpt: My cordial greetings and best wishes
shared_material.explanation: The child retains the compact best-wishes formulation while expanding the surrounding sentiment.
